result.question: What did Abimelech do with silver?

readings.answer: He hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
readings.support: Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him

assessments.reason: The text says the silver was used to hire “worthless and reckless men,” which is equivalent in meaning to “wicked and violent men.”

result.reason: The passage explicitly states Abimelech used the silver to hire worthless/reckless men, matching the key’s wicked/violent men.
